# Lines that keep the product's old name, which no pattern of docs/internal-names.md covers: PATH<TAB>TEXT<TAB>WHY.
# TEXT is the part of a line of PATH (the old name inside it) that stays; tests/brand_check.py fails on an entry
# that no longer matches anything.
# No exemptions at v0.45.0: every spelling that stays is a pattern of docs/internal-names.md.
